The season ran from August 23, 1996, to August 13, 1997.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg97.html Argentina 1996–97] by Mariano Dicapua on RSSSF.com [[Huracán Corrientes]] (champion of [[1995–96 Primera B Nacional]]) and [[Unión de Santa Fe]] promoted from [[Primera B Nacional]]. [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] won both, Apertura and Clausura championships (27th. and 28th. league titles). On the other hand, Huracán Corrientes and [[Club Atlético Banfield|Banfield]] were relegated with the worst points averages."Argentina: 1ra.
